name: @dsh-desktop/desktop
author: ZeroY <zeroy1024@outlook.com>
description: Electron 壳：主进程负责窗口、安全策略与 dsh agent 子进程生命周期。

scripts.package: pnpm --dir ../.. build && tsx ./stage-runtime-archive.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --dir ../.. build && tsx ./stage-runtime-archive.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
scripts.package:ci:linux: tsx ./stage-runtime-archive.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux dir tar.gz --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --dir ../.. build && tsx ./stage-runtime-archive.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: pnpm --dir ../.. build && tsx ./stage-runtime-archive.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
